headline: SoftBank CEO Explores $1 Trillion Buyout of SK Hynix
summary: SoftBank Group CEO Masayoshi Son has reportedly approached Wall Street institutions to discuss financing a potential $1 trillion buyout of South Korean memory chip manufacturer SK Hynix.
why: SK Hynix is a critical player in the global semiconductor supply chain, particularly for high-bandwidth memory used in AI applications. A deal of this magnitude would be the largest in corporate history.

impacts.name: SK Hynix
impacts.why: News of a potential buyout at a premium typically drives the target's share price higher.
